raw_capture.note: Sources were inspected as rendered web pages or public API responses. Raw response bytes were not persisted in this record. Do not admit these observations to the point-in-time feature store or training set.

forecast.reason: No synchronized raw receipts, complete point-in-time market dataset, leakage-safe XRP-specific out-of-sample lift, calibrated probabilities and completed shadow evaluation have been established.

sbi_holdings.evidence_note: SBI Holdings' own FY2025 presentation calls Ripple an SBI Group investee and states an approximately 9% stake. This is corporate equity exposure, not an XRP wallet balance.
sbi_holdings.sbi_specific_xrp_purchase_allocation_not: Not separately allocated in the SEC purchase tranche.

sbi_ripple_supply_slide.semantic_guard: The slide labels approximately 5.10B as Actual XRP within Ripple's holdings not in circulation. It is not an SBI Holdings balance.

post_close.note: 346,484,972 transferred to Pathfinder plus 126,791,458 separately contributed by Ripple equals 473,276,430. This is a transaction/closing reconciliation, not a verified current balance.

ownership_constraints.sbi_threshold_semantics: Class A ownership threshold; excess shares issued as Class C. Not a total economic ownership cap.

relationship_roles.coinbase: Principal market used for XRP accounting valuation and an announced institutional deployment partner; this does not establish Coinbase ownership or custody of the full treasury.
relationship_roles.bitgo: Identified initial digital-asset custodian in the filing's custody history.
relationship_roles.ripple: Related party, direct XRP contributor, credit counterparty and announced deployment partner.
relationship_roles.rippleworks: Separate entity from Ripple Labs; source of XRP contributed through the sponsor.

evernorth_sec_reconciliation.impairment_reconciliation_note: Historical cost 846,575,043 less cumulative impairment since inception 504,687,812 equals September 30 carrying value 341,887,231. The 271,037,170 figure is the nine-month 2026 impairment, not cumulative since inception; Q3 2026 alone was 6,891,073.

caveats: Moved outside the attributed wallet set does not prove sale or loss of custody.
The page's timeline says no closing filing was found and describes XRPN as awaiting listing, despite the SEC filing confirming the October 9 close.
The page discusses a 200,000 XRP delayed-funding deposit; the 200,138 XRP arithmetic difference requires transaction-level reconciliation.

usdc_circulation.interpretation: Cross-snapshot supply contraction only; not a direct XRP flow or evidence of XRPL demand.

arc_presale.note: Circle's revenue recognized is not the same as the full presale proceeds or SBI's undisclosed allocation.

network_scope.note: Native USDC availability on XRPL is a product/network connection, not proof of a direct Ripple-Circle corporate partnership or XRP buying.

kraken_xrpusd.note: Single-venue retrieval snapshot; no exchange event timestamp was exposed.

exchange_wallets.note: XRP Insights reads XRPL balances and uses XRPSCAN labels. Same-wallet declines cannot distinguish customer withdrawals from exchange transfers to untracked wallets.

etfs.flow_semantics: Issuer-reported XRP holdings delta; not automatically net cash purchases or exchange-market buys.

derivatives.note: Third-party OI values differ materially by venue, contract type and update clock. No synchronized direct venue OI set was admitted.

exact_phrase_and_identity.actual_capital: No new primary exact-phrase match. SBI's official presentation uses 'Actual XRP' for Ripple's approximately 5.10B non-escrow XRP holdings; this is not SBI's token balance.
exact_phrase_and_identity.ask_coin: Permission Coin (ASK) and a separate Ask Coin Telegram candidate remain unresolved; no verified XRP/Ripple relationship.
exact_phrase_and_identity.sbic_chatgpt: No primary evidence of a ChatGPT/OpenAI relationship with SBIC East/Central/West.
exact_phrase_and_identity.kamilah_camilla_stevenson: Prior first-person identity evidence remains; canonical YouTube channel ownership remains unverified; no new video admitted.

source_conflicts_and_counter_hypotheses: Evernorth's reported 473.276M XRP starting treasury is not equivalent to 473.276M fresh cash purchases; contributions and in-kind transfers are material.
The 126.791M Ripple contribution was available for operating costs, creating potential sale/financing supply; no sale quantity is established.
Evernorth's 370.347M XRP moved outside the attributed wallet set may be custody movement, not sale; tracker is stale and its arithmetic is off by 200,138 XRP.
Exchange-wallet declines may reflect wallet relabeling or transfers to untracked wallets, not customer withdrawals or tradable-float contraction.
ETF holdings deltas are not automatically cash flows; the tracker excludes GXRP flow while a data gap is corrected.
USDC supply contraction may reflect stablecoin redemptions or market demand changes; it does not imply XRP flows.
feature_candidates_not_admitted: Evernorth holdings by legal entity, custodian and on-chain wallet with SEC-to-ledger reconciliation.
Cash-funded XRP purchases separated from in-kind contributions, sponsor transfers and related-party contributions.
XRP exchange-wallet balances with stable wallet-set versioning, cold/hot labels and wrapped-reserve exclusions.
Issuer-by-issuer ETF XRP holdings changes, cash creations/redemptions and in-kind legs separated.
USDC and RLUSD supply by chain, mint/burn, bridge and redemption activity.
Synchronized spot order-book depth, futures OI/funding/basis and liquidation feeds.
